description: Relay a message to a client through the agency communication gateway (their WhatsApp / iMessage and email). Agency staff keys only. TWO-STEP: confirm=false (default) returns the plan only (client, channels, live or dry-run, exact preview text, warnings) and sends nothing; call again with confirm=true only after the user approves the exact preview. Live delivery is still governed by the gateway's transport allowlist.

attribution.description: agent = BAMF Bot's voice; from_me = signed with the sender's name and role.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name (must be a client of an agency you own, admin, or manage).

confirm.description: false returns the plan only; true sends.

link.description: Optional https URL appended to the message.

message.description: Write as the client should read it: second person, plain, no greeting.

name: bamf.message_client
